items.title_en: A High-Density EEG Dataset for Stimulus-Driven Auditory Attention
bullets_zh: 提出用于刺激驱动听觉注意的高密度EEG数据集。
面向无明确目标、多声源竞争下的无指令聆听场景。
支持非侵入式BCI的注意解码与基准评测研究。
bullets_en: Introduces a high-density EEG dataset for stimulus-driven auditory attention.
Targets instruction-free listening where multiple sound sources compete without an explicit goal.
Supports non-invasive BCI research on attention decoding and benchmarking.
items.brief: 提供高密度EEG数据集，支持无指令听觉注意解码与评测。
items.brief_en: Provides a high-density EEG dataset for instruction-free auditory attention decoding and evaluation.
items.raw_excerpt: Stimulus-driven auditory attention determines which sound gains priority when multiple sources compete without an explicit listening goal, yet most computational studies focus either on acoustic salience or on decoding predefined attended targets. 这避免了评估这些 SSVEP 分类器时加载 NumPy 数组导致的错误。

This prevents NumPy array loading errors when evaluating those SSVEP classifiers.

items.raw_excerpt: Pass epochs to SSVEP_itCCA and SSVEP_eCCA in evaluations (#1187) _pipeline_requires_epochs only knew SSVEP_CCA, SSVEP_TRCA and SSVEP_MsetCCA, so an evaluation run with SSVEP_itCCA or SSVEP_eCCA loaded NumPy arrays and the classifier's fit raised "X should be an MNE Epochs object.". Add both classes to the check. Signed-off-by: Bru Co-authored-by: Bru <b.aristimunha@gmail.
